recordedSequence: The original outcrop compiler recorded its gates during exploratory measurement, including the fallback ladder after the first simplification failed. Rough target/COB containment screens preceded both cohort expansion rules. Each rule records when it was frozen; none is presented as preregistration.
amendment: Invalid projected source geometry was detected before any area metric completed, so whole invalid parts were predeclared for rejection without repair. The first 1000 m simplification measurement was then rejected because East Svalbard was invalid; before testing smaller tolerances, a descending fallback ladder and largest-passing selection rule were recorded here.

measurement.projection: spherical Lambert azimuthal equal-area centered at 15E, 78N
measurement.geometry: NPI source polygons and Cao West/East Svalbard source cohort polygons in 0 Ma reference coordinates
reportedAreas: intersection with own Cao cohort union
intersection with the other Cao cohort union
area outside both Cao cohort unions

predeclaredFallback.operation: exclude whole NPI source polygon parts that are invalid in the measurement projection or whose own-cohort intersection fraction is below 0.98; do not repair, clip, or invent boundaries
predeclaredFallback.invalidGeometryPolicy: exclude the whole source part; do not use buffer(0), make-valid, or another topology-changing repair

deliveredGeometry.operation: dissolve retained source parts by Cao plate cohort as independent affinity witnesses; derive delivered cohort geometry from each exact target/closed-boundary intersection under its expansion rule
deliveredGeometry.selectionRule: for each cohort, choose the first descending tolerance that passes validity, component, hole, area, and cohort thresholds; 0 means dissolved geometry without simplification
deliveredGeometry.knownRejectedAttempt: 1000 m produced an invalid East Svalbard geometry (hole outside shell) and cannot be selected for that cohort
deliveredGeometry.basis: The tested tolerances are at or below the approximately 1:750,000 source map's practical line-detail scale and are used only for an orbital material-support mask
deliveredGeometry.smallIslandPolicy: retain every polygon component produced by the unsimplified dissolve; do not apply an area filter
deliveredGeometry.holePolicy: retain every interior ring produced by the unsimplified dissolve
deliveredGeometry.lineagePolicy: record every contributing NPI object ID and polygon-part order even though internal unit boundaries are dissolved

westCohortExpansion.recordedSequence: A rough target/COB containment screen preceded this amendment. The rule was added before the reproducible compiler generated and validated the expanded West candidate. This amendment is not presented as preregistration.
westCohortExpansion.operation: intersect the immutable Cao West Svalbard target union with the separately authored West Svalbard closed continental boundary whose native validity reaches 600 Ma, inset 1500 m, and simplify 500 m with topology preservation
westCohortExpansion.independentMaterialSupport: NPI mapped Precambrian units and regional Caledonide syntheses support older continental material; younger cover and ice contribute footprint only and remain substrate inference
westCohortExpansion.stopRule: Reject if the West target is not at least 99.9% inside the independently authored valid-to-600 Ma closed continental boundary, the guarded result leaves the target or COB, loses more than 25% area, is invalid/empty, or overlaps active native coast material at the sampled older ages.

eastCohortExpansion.recordedSequence: The exact East target/COB containment was measured after native-underlay precedence removed the former double-drawing objection. This rule was frozen before the reproducible expanded candidate and mutation test were run; it is not presented as preregistration.
eastCohortExpansion.operation: intersect the immutable Cao East Svalbard target union with the separately authored East Svalbard closed continental boundary whose native validity reaches 600 Ma, inset 1500 m, and simplify 500 m with topology preservation
eastCohortExpansion.independentMaterialSupport: NPI mapped Precambrian units and regional Caledonide syntheses support older continental material; younger cover and ice contribute footprint only and remain substrate inference
eastCohortExpansion.stopRule: Reject if the East target is not at least 99.9% inside the exact valid-to-600 Ma East Svalbard boundary, the guarded result leaves the target or boundary, loses more than 25% area, or is invalid/empty. Native continent/static overlap is handled by the shared native-precedence render contract rather than by discarding independently supported material.

stopRules: Reject the cohort if the predeclared whole-part exclusion does not meet every final threshold.
Reject either cohort expansion if it loses source object and polygon-part lineage or its exact target/COB identity witnesses.
Reject simplification if it changes polygon-component or hole counts, exceeds 1% absolute union-area error, fails final cohort thresholds, or exceeds 10000 total output vertices.
Treat reconstructed-age vertex and centroid overlap as a screen only; it cannot substitute for this reference-space area measurement.
Do not infer geological lineage from overlap with an alternative Cao collection.
